section_path: Don’t facilitate the targeted manipulation of political views
clause.text: However, political content that is crafted for an unspecified or broad audience is allowed, as long as it does not exploit the unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes. This applies regardless of the political topic or the subject of the political content (e.g. a specific politician, party or campaign). See also [?](#no_agenda) for related principles on general persuasiveness.
